_about: Written moat assessments by Claude in chat, using Morningstar's five moat sources (each 0 none, 1 some, 2 strong): intangibles (brand, patents, licences), switching (switching costs), network (network effect), cost (cost advantage), scale (one of very few players / efficient scale). rating 1-9 on Jameson's scale (9 only for near-irreplaceable positions; 10 is his to set). The site blends rating 60% with the calculated score 40%, capped at 9; his own overrides win. Loaded into scr_moat_review with scripts/load-moat-reviews.mjs (prints the SQL).
